name: endpoint-attest
description: Time-bounded, owner-requested security attestations for a network endpoint: the operator proves control of the endpoint, a check is run, and the outcome is recorded as a signed, content-addressed, expiring attestation. Reuses capacity-attest's canonical hashing and EIP-191 signing rather than reimplementing them. Never a security score, never a claim about a party that did not ask.
author: holistis
